strongest_angle: Cardi B and Offset reached a confidential out-of-court settlement on November 25, 2026, dismissing the lawsuit brought by property owner Bi LLC over the unauthorized music video shoot at a Beverly Hills mansion.

key_facts.fact: Cardi B and Offset reached a confidential settlement dismissing the lawsuit over the Beverly Hills mansion used for the 'Like What' music video, as reported by Rolling Stone on November 25, 2026.
The lawsuit brought by property owner Bi LLC against Cardi B and Offset was dismissed after a confidential settlement, removing a scheduled January 5 trial date from the court docket.
Property owner Bi LLC accused Cardi B and Offset of filming the 'Like What' music video at the Beverly Hills mansion under the false guise of shooting a TikTok clip.
